{{Quote|I'm TH-313&ndash;you can call me 'Tacker,' though not that many people do these days. I have a funny feeling that this meeting wasn't just chance. You remind me a lot of someone I knew once, a long time ago&hellip;|Tacker, to a group of Force-sensitives|<ref name="CotG" />}}
'''Tacker''', designated '''TH-313''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] under [[Suljo Warde]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he became a [[Clone stormtrooper|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. Though initially loyal to the Empire, TH-313 came to regret the events of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="CotG" />
